en: A sepia-toned studio portrait of a young couple, likely from the early 20th century. The woman, in a light-colored, lace-trimmed dress, holds a basket of large flowers. The man, in a striped suit and tie, stands closely beside her with his arm around her, both smiling slightly. They pose in front of a painted backdrop featuring a small tree or plant. The photograph is printed in an oval vignette and surrounded by a faux-wood printed border, resembling a framed picture. No visible writing or postal markings appear on the image side.
